description: Submit one of the person's draft (or rejected) releases for review and publishing. Needs a cover, the AI labelling, at least one track, all tracks processed (ready) and a complete artist verification; otherwise the answer lists what is missing. Because the release becomes public, nothing is submitted yet: the person confirms the rights and the submission in the browser (you get a confirmUrl to give them), studio_request_status shows the outcome. After that Bitsound reviews the release.
name: studio_release_submit
title: Submit a release for publishing
